messages:
Lina K: hi folks, new hire here — stuck in an Okta redirect loop on my company MacBook M1 after approving Okta Verify. Google Drive and 1Password show as 'needs access'. anyone know a quick fix? :confused:
IT Bot: Ticket created: #IT-4629 — assigned to Alex Chen. Please include browser + version and device serial for triage.
Alex Chen: welcome @Lina K. quick Qs: which browser? did you accept the device enrollment prompt? any MDM profile present under System Settings > Profiles?
Lina K: Chrome 119.0, fresh device, no profile appeared. serial: C02MN0ABC456. I did install 1Password from the store and logged my personal account there.
Alex Chen: ok. two common causes: (1) Device Trust not registered (no corporate MDM profile), or (2) browser cookies interfering. try an incognito window and also check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles.
Lina K: incognito still loops. no profiles listed.
Priya R: @Alex FYI Lina started yesterday; she's already in the 'eng' group in Google Workspace. we can re-add to onboarding drive if needed.
Alex Chen: thanks. tagging @Samir to check the group sync and Okta DT logs for lina.k@redwood.ai.
Samir B: looking now — user provisioned into eng group ~4h ago. Okta shows SAML sessions but no Device Trust enrollment event from that device serial. MDM enrollment likely blocked at Jamf stage.
Alex Chen: short-term options: (A) we can create time-limited access links for Drive and 1Password so she can proceed, or (B) we can push Jamf enrollment invite to her email to install the corporate profile. which do you prefer?
Lina K: prefer temp links so I can finish setup today. will do Jamf enrollment after.
Alex Chen: creating temp links and flagging them in the ticket. also try installing Okta Verify on your phone and using the mobile push instead of browser MFA — sometimes Chrome extensions or settings break the embedded flow.
IT Bot: One-time links created: Drive (expires in 3h) and 1Password vault access (expires in 4h). Links posted to ticket #IT-4629.
Lina K: Drive link works, I can see team folders. 1Password link opened a session into the shared vault; invite still shows pending but I can access secrets. thanks!
Alex Chen: good. I'll schedule Jamf enrollment push for 15:30 PT. please accept the profile while on Redwood VPN or your home network. once the MDM profile is installed Device Trust should apply and the SSO redirect loop will stop.
Priya R: welcome again @Lina K :tada: — let me know if you need any extra access to onboarding docs.
Lina K: thanks everyone — appreciate the fast help. will update the ticket after enrolling.
Alex Chen: marking thread follow-up scheduled. if the Jamf push fails, collect console logs and paste them here and I will escalate to Apple MDM team.
